en: A vintage, monochrome postcard showing a large complex of multi‑storey institutional buildings surrounded by trees and open fields in the background. The prominent foreground building is an ornate multi‑wing structure with a clock above the central entrance. Other barrack‑like buildings extend further back. German captions are printed in red at the top and left margins, identifying the scene as a military barracks and justice building in Freiberg in Saxony.
